verdict.summary: The change is internally consistent and appropriately scoped as an interim, explicitly oracle-dependent differential-harvest tool. The comparison uses raw parser output rather than store-normalized values, graph results are checked isomorphically, negative cases are honestly described as oracle-rejected rather than proven invalid, and the seeded self-test exercises both positive-result comparison and negative acceptance detection. The research record clearly separates executed evidence, source-read conclusions, suspected follow-up work, and limitations; the two proposed upstream reports match the described RDF 1.2 grammar and parser-state omissions. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test defect requiring changes was found in the supplied diff.
